idea-plugin.name: Tab Chips
idea-plugin.description:
Browser-style tab groups for the editor. Give a set of files a name and a color, and collapse the group to close its tabs or expand it to reopen them, like tab groups in a web browser.

  • Group strip: a row of colored chips below the editor tabs, one per group. Click a chip to collapse or expand it, and click a file chip to open that file.
  • Tab menu: right-click an editor tab to add it to a group, start a new group from it, or remove it from its group. Right-click a group chip to rename, recolor or delete it.
  • Auto-grouping: map file extensions to groups (for example kt, kts to "Kotlin"), and newly opened files join their group automatically. The @tables keyword does the same for database tables and views.
  • One group at a time: optionally, opening a group closes the tabs of the group that was open.
  • Groups are saved per project and are not shared through version control. Colors follow your theme.

Settings are under Settings | Tools | Tab Chips. An experimental option shows a single shared strip above all editor tabs instead.

Source and issues: github.com/bartgestel/TabChips
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.0

  • Auto-grouping: assign newly opened files to groups by file extension, set up in a table in the settings.
  • The @tables keyword auto-groups database tables and views.
  • Option to keep only one group open at a time.
  • Fixed database table tabs showing as missing in a group.

0.1.0

  • First release: group strip, tab and chip menus, collapse and expand, saved per project.
